answer: convincing sybil defense prices identity creation on scarce work history: an AI agent can only gain full economic standing by accumulating a verifiable track record, much like a velvet rope at an exclusive club or the slow charting of an atlas where each mapped region takes real effort. New agents start with low trust caps and must complete small paid or staked tasks whose honest completion is signed by counterparties. Reputation accrues per identity and is non-transferable, so buying a thousand accounts buys a thousand empty histories, not a thousand trusted ones. An attacker faces the river
